description: This file defines the RxSchedulers class, which manages and provides access to main thread and background schedulers for reactive programming using RxJava in an Android environment.

classes.name: RxSchedulers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to access main thread and background schedulers for RxJava operations in Android.

methods.name: setSchedulers
methods.description: Initializes the main thread and background schedulers using the provided Looper and Scheduler.

methods.name: mainThread
methods.description: Returns the Scheduler associated with the main thread.

methods.name: background
methods.description: Returns the Scheduler used for background operations.
